name: ctx-heavy
description: Second footer line under herdr-jump: your heaviest herdr sessions by context, wherever they are, each with its prompt cache's time left (from cache-timer), click one to go there; settings pick what a row shows (context, cache or both) and the order (biggest, or closest to expiring); sessions an agent drives (turn-mode agentic) are left out

show.title: What each session shows
show.description: After its pane ID: its context size, its prompt cache's time left (from cache-timer), or both.

order.title: Which sessions, in what order
order.description: context: the biggest contexts first. cache: the warm caches closest to expiring first, then the rest, biggest first.

expired.title: Sessions whose cache has expired
expired.description: hide: list only sessions whose prompt cache is still warm (or in use by a turn). show: list them all. Sessions cache-timer does not run in are always listed.
